prompt.tipos: Context, container, component, deployment, sequence, state, entity-relationship, and data flow. Use flowchart, sequenceDiagram, stateDiagram-v2, erDiagram, or C4Context. Use architecture-beta only when the renderer in the project supports it.

minimo.nivel: Context, plus one sequence when a flow is in scope.
Context, container, deployment, the key sequences, and an entity-relationship diagram when a data model exists.

reglas.regla: The .mmd file is the source. The SAD links to it. A fenced copy in Markdown must match the file.
Label the diagram AS-IS, TO-BE, PROPOSED, or IMPLEMENTED. An invented target is PROPOSED, never IMPLEMENTED.
Split a diagram that is too dense to read.
When mermaid-cli is available, validate syntax and record the command. When it is not, record syntax not validated. Do not write valid.
A database phase produces the entity-relationship diagram. A design phase produces the views the SAD needs.
